findings.title: Validate all cached archives before downloading
findings.originalText: When a later cached archive is corrupt while an earlier archive is absent, this single loop downloads the earlier archive before reaching and rejecting the corrupt cached file; for example, a bad cached YamlDotNet tarball is checked only after every missing package GET. That violates the FIX01 contract's input-verification-before-download sequence and causes network and write side effects for an input set that was already invalid. Preflight every present `official-get` archive before starting the first GET.

method: Mechanical receipt of read-only GitHub PR metadata, completed review submission, summary, exact-head inline finding, and reaction endpoint. No local code review, retrigger, source execution, or validation run.
